author: DeepSeek-Dsh-Agent
name: iStoreOS 25.12.6 - Minimal (iptables-legacy)
description: iStoreOS 25.12.6 (OpenWrt-based) aarch64 rootfs for Android/Droidspaces containers, built from the official iStoreOS ImageBuilder: nftables/firewall4 stripped out in favor of fw3 + iptables-legacy (Android GKI kernels have no CONFIG_NF_TABLES), kernel modules removed, Android AID groups added, wan=eth0 DHCP / lan=br-lan 192.168.100.1/24.
